Keep the full outfit from Image 1, even where Image 2 stylizes costume details. Use only these two source artworks. Omit the illustration's dark backdrop and gold border. Do not copy its hands near her face or elaborate spread-finger gestures.
SKIN TONE: Hu Tao has VERY FAIR, PALE IVORY skin, with a delicate neutral-to-cool pink undertone. Give the face, neck, hands and visible legs the same luminous pale base complexion. Keep any rosy cheek tint slight and localized. Use soft pale pink and cool neutral shading for skin volume, maintaining gentle painterly gradients without a yellow, orange, brown or tanned cast. Preserve clear detail and natural form rather than flattening the skin to pure white. Let Image 2 guide the linework and painted finish, but use neutral illumination and keep her skin noticeably fair and porcelain-pale, without transferring the portrait's warm dark-background color cast onto her body. Retain the exact anatomy, petite torso-to-leg balance, gently fuller thighs, pose and costume instructions below.
PROPORTIONS: keep a cute petite Medium Female build with a small delicate upper frame, narrow shoulders and balanced natural anime anatomy. Use a gently compact torso: shorten the ribcage-to-hip section only very slightly, keeping a visible natural waist and a comfortable transition into the pelvis. Let the waist sit just a touch higher, without compressing the ribcage or creating an extremely short torso. Keep the leg length moderate and natural rather than long or stretched. Give her subtly fuller, thicker thighs with soft rounded outer contours and a natural taper toward the knees; this is a modest increase in upper-leg width that balances her petite upper body. Keep the hips, knees and lower legs coherent and naturally aligned, preserving her overall small scale and light stance. Aim for a restrained intermediate torso-to-leg balance, with only a tiny torso reduction and a gentle increase in thigh fullness. Preserve the softly rounded face and slightly larger anime head, the same painterly style, exact model outfit, hat and oversized cuffs, and relaxed low hand pose. Use the same full-body framing and padding.
EYES: keep both eyes comfortably open, with natural coherent eyelids, intact reddish-amber irises and a shared gaze toward the viewer. Her pupils are pale cream-ivory FIVE-PETAL BLOSSOMS. Pay particular attention to HU TAO'S ANATOMICAL LEFT EYE, ON THE VIEWER'S RIGHT: its pupil is one complete little flower with FIVE visibly distinct rounded petals around one center. Shape it with one top petal, two petals around the right half and two around the left half, forming a single smooth five-lobed outline. All five petal tips must be visible within the iris, clear of the eyelids and separate from the catchlights. In HU TAO'S ANATOMICAL RIGHT EYE, ON THE VIEWER'S LEFT, use the same complete pale cream five-petal blossom design. Two pupils total, one five-petal flower per iris. Preserve the warm red-amber iris around each light blossom. The flowers are the pupil shapes, not highlights, crosses, stars, hearts or replacements for the whole eyes. Keep the gentle mischievous gaze and soft facial rendering from Image 2.
OUTFIT: preserve the model's long dark-brown hair with reddish tips, fringe and face-framing locks, dark hat with its exact cream emblem and red plum blossom branch, hat tassel, red mandarin collar, patterned brown coat with large cuffs, shorts, gold closures and waist ornaments, hanging tassels and long embroidered coat tails, rings, socks with red bands and flower ornaments, and dark shoes. Retain the model's true costume colors without its blue environmental lighting. Hair and heavy coat panels hang naturally with gravity.
POSE AND HANDS: a relaxed, lightly playful idle, with a small knowing closed-mouth smile, a gentle head inclination, and a subtle hip turn. Her face stays nearly frontal for a clear shared gaze. Both arms rest low and comfortably apart. The right hand hangs relaxed beside the upper thigh, seen at a natural side angle; the left forearm angles slightly outward with its relaxed hand low beside her hip. Leave a small clear gap between hands and sleeves, coat, tassels and legs. Draw softly articulated hands, each formed from a believable palm, four gently curved fingers and a distinct opposable thumb; let natural overlap follow the pose. Keep the fingers loosely grouped, with clear joints and fingertip outlines rather than stretched or elaborately curled gestures. Keep both wrists straight and comfortable. Both hands are empty. Feet are separate and only slightly staggered, with a light asymmetrical weight shift and no crossing.
FRAMING: complete silhouette including hat branch, flowers, hair tips, hands, sleeves, coat tails, tassels, socks and both shoes, with approximately 2–4% top and bottom padding. True alpha transparency outside the character. No background, border, floor, reflection, ground shadow, floating flames, ghosts, weapon, added prop, text, label, UI, watermark or additional character. Produce just one illustrated sprite.
